task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel LSV benchmark chart, variant 03. Scenario: anodic OER LSV.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel linear sweep voltammetry / polarization curve benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Whole figure is the target panel. Axes are fully enclosed by a rectangular border. Legend is inside the panel at upper left. A gray dashed horizontal guideline is present near 10 mA cm^-2 but is not an axis feature.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: The three monotonic traces remain visually separated across the plot; only intentional dash gaps are present.

curves.overlap_notes: No true occlusion; the low-current left baseline region sits close to the other traces, and QA raised a false marker-style advisory on the thick solid stroke.
Intentional dash gaps only; legend dash at upper left was ignored. Separation from the neighboring traces is narrow only in the far-left low-current region.
Intentional dash-dot gaps only; legend glyph and gray horizontal guideline were excluded. Separation from NiFeOOH is narrow only in the far-left low-current region.

response.interpretation_notes: Single main plot with three labeled LSV-style traces. The gray dashed horizontal line near 10 mA cm^-2 is a guide line, not a target curve. Overlap QA reported only low-current left-edge crowding and a likely false marker heuristic on the thick black stroke.
unresolved_ambiguities: The three traces are closely spaced near the left baseline (roughly x=156-276 px), which triggers pairwise overlap review despite preserved curve identity.
The black IrO2 trace received a marker-rim advisory from QA even though the visible stroke is a plain solid line; this appears to be a heuristic false positive.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
